However, this is the inverse of the correct implication. The natural language implies that recognition follows from breakthroughs (p_8 → p_9), but the FOL wrongly states that lack of recognition implies no breakthroughs. This commits the converse error. While the earlier FOL p_8(Eric) → p_9(Eric) correctly captures that breakthroughs lead to recognition, this last one incorrectly reverses the logic. Therefore, the mapping is invalid.
